method: scripts/hook-log-build.py: studio.db publishing + latest API snapshot (perVideo90d, 90-day window) + production hook/story/script-doctor/viral json; null = unknown

videos.title: TOP 5 DIVING-BOARD FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five divers whose best move was the splat, and the Olympic #1 scored zero.
videos.story_spine: Five dive fails, and each splat looks like the worst, but only one dive at the Olympics scored zero, therefore #1 is the flat landing that cost a diver everything.

videos.title: TOP 5 SLIP FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A woman vs one algae-covered stream rock: she is totally sure of her footing.

videos.title: TOP 5 BASKETBALL DUNK-FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: One college dunker hangs on the rim, flips, and does not stick the landing, and he tops five dunks that went wrong.
videos.story_spine: Everyone thinks a dunk always lands, but five dunks show it does not, therefore #1 (the rim hang that ends without a stuck landing) is the one to send.

videos.title: TOP 5 FREESTYLE-FOOTBALL TRICK MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A freestyler flips upside down and the ball does not fall: five tricks, ranked by how much happens before the ball drops.
videos.story_spine: Five freestyle tricks ranked by what the ball survives; each rung adds a property (clean, two balls, a jump, a cartwheel), therefore #1 is a handstand with the ball still on her foot for two seconds.

videos.title: TOP 5 HOVERBOARD FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A backyard rider vs a patio and a pool

videos.title: TOP 5 HALF-COURT SHOT MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five half-court heaves at the buzzer, and the last one ends the game
videos.story_spine: Five half-court heaves, and each one looks impossible, but only one lands at zero seconds with the game on the line, therefore #1 is Giddey's buzzer winner.

videos.title: TOP 5 BACKFLIP FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five backflips that did not stick, ranked by how hard the landing hit; #1 is a named star on the Coachella stage.
videos.story_spine: Five backflips that did not stick, and each one lands harder than the last, but only one is a star flat on a festival stage, therefore #1 is the Coachella crash.

videos.title: TOP 5 CHEERLEADING STUNT MOMENTS
videos.hook_mechanism: Glimpse Tease + Mute-Proof Overlay (adapts brand default)
videos.hook_premise: Five cheer tosses, ranked by how high the flyer goes: #1 rises past the very top of the frame.
videos.story_spine: Five cheer tosses, and each looks high, but only one sends the flyer to the top edge of the frame, therefore #1 is the basket toss that leaves the screen.

videos.title: TOP 5 MOUNTAIN-BIKE JUMP MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five mountain bike flips ranked by ranked by hang time: #1 is a backflip that hangs high above a whole valley.
videos.story_spine: Five mountain bike flips, and each one stays up longer or drops farther, but a 75 foot canyon gap still is not the biggest, therefore #1 is the flip that hangs over a whole valley.

videos.title: TOP 5 DANCE FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five dancers whose best move was gravity: ranked by crash size vs how confident the move looked.

videos.title: TOP 5 KAYAK FLIP MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five paddlers go off a dock, steps or lock wall sure of it, and each flip gets wilder; #1 is a tumble down a weir into whitewater foam, and he comes up fine.

videos.title: TOP 5 WEDDING FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A perfect wedding day, and five guests confidently prove it wrong; #1 is a bridesmaid who limbos under a bar and ends up laughing on the lawn.

videos.title: TOP 5 REFLEX SAVE MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five saves nobody had time to think about, and #1 is a keeper in a full-stretch flying dive who tips it away with his fingertips.

videos.title: TOP 5 ROLLER SKATE MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A dad vs a whole roller rink: he goes full send and slides across it on his seat. Who wipes out biggest?

videos.title: TOP 5 TRICK SHOT MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A shooter far behind the court vs a rim-cam: the ball arcs into the camera and still goes through the net.

videos.title: TOP 5 PARKOUR LANDING MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five parkour landings, one 11 m crane drop into a haystack: who sticks it cleanest?

videos.title: TOP 5 WATERSLIDE FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A water slide promises a gentle ride; #1 flings a woman airborne for 4 seconds before she lands.

videos.title: TOP 5 SKI CRASH MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: A helper vs one fallen skier: she tries to haul her friend up and goes down too.

videos.title: TOP 5 GYM FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five gym fails ranked by how badly the machine wins: a treadmill row vs one man, and the treadmill throws him into a full flip.

videos.title: TOP 5 SCOOTER FAIL MOMENTS

videos.title: TOP 5 ICE SLIP MOMENTS

videos.title: TOP 5 TRAMPOLINE FAIL MOMENTS

videos.title: TOP 5 PARKOUR FAIL MOMENTS

videos.title: TOP 5 BIKE FAIL MOMENTS
videos.hook_premise: Five riders go full send and the plan falls apart; #1 is a mega-ramp backflip that ends against the wall. Every rider walks away (confirm for #1).

videos.hook_premise: Five airborne stunts, one judge: which flip is #1?
